notes.content:

Ahoy!

VR Regatta 1.1beta has just shipped with some major engine improvements and bug fixes!

Changes

     Performance optimizations - We've optimized the game in various places and overall it should run much smoother.
     Fixed minor issues with 3D text in levels 
     Ability to setup private "Daily Race" for events ( contact us ahoy@marineverse.com for more details )
     Made "Fastest" quality water infinite
     Added Oculus controller models in the multiplayer 
     Game engine update ( Unity ) - This is actually a big change, if you notice any issues, please let us know on the forum


This is a beta update in preparation for cross-play with Oculus Home. Proper 1.1 is expected with future Oculus Home release. If you want, you can opt-in into stable_1_0 branch if you prefer to stay on the old version.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l7KtnxppP_U
If you experience any problems or issues with the update, please let us know on the forum and we will try to fix: https://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/1/

Best regards,
MarineVerse team

notes.title: A big year of VR Regatta is over, with huge news to come! 💨⛵
notes.content:
Hello there, digital sailors!

2017 is sailing into the sunset, bringing to an end our biggest year so far of appearances and demos for VR Regatta. We’ve had a very eventful twelve months, and 2018 is already shaping up to be even busier!

Here is just a sampling of the things we got up to during 2017:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/3e059f5c2def22650af78479f0ad6a94cd541b18.gif


 ⛵ MarineVerse was officially incorporated as a company in Australia.
 ⛵ We demoed VR Regatta several times in our hometown of Melbourne, including exhibiting at PauseFest, an event dedicated to innovative technology and exciting startups, and giving racing fans a taste of sailing at the Australian Grand Prix in cooperation with Australian Sailing. We also showed it at the Melbourne Boat Show, the Royal Brighton Yacht Club, and more.
 ⛵ We travelled around the world to show off our game, including demonstrating it to experienced sailors at the Singapore Yacht Show and partnering with M&G team to deliver a virtual sailing experience at a conference in Davos, Switzerland.
 ⛵ It gave us a great sense of validation to be awarded a production grant from Film Victoria to help us develop our game by hiring some talented new people.
 ⛵ An astonishing 4,000 virtual sailors in over 80 countries played VR Regatta in 2017.
 ⛵ We’re not quite done yet! VR Regatta will be showcase at the Melbourne stopover of the Volvo Ocean Race on 28 December.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/596d198cba19d3461ccfdb1971454b1fb1720168.jpg


We already have big plans for 2018, mainly the official launch of the game in the first quarter of 2018.  Stay tuned for our release date! After our great experience this year, we will also be returning to PauseFest 2018 to exhibit again.


Our sincere thanks go out to everyone who has played our game, given us feedback, reported a bug, or done anything else to help make VR Regatta: The Sailing Game even better. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/f83d30008c2f44fc24892f46b2f3055ad8a62424.jpg


It’s been an incredibly challenging and exhausting year with a lot of hard work and long hours of travelling, but it’s worth it to work on a project that we love so much. You can keep up with the latest by following us on Twitter or checking in on our blog.

What are you looking forward to in 2018?

Greg on behalf MarineVerse Team
https://www.marineverse.com/

notes.title: New islands in VR Regatta 0.9
notes.content:
We've just shipped an update to our sailing game :-)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/3fc2a2c1bc11ae69a111c87f657b775a50c7a681.jpg

Change log

     New starting area - your own relaxing sailing hut
     New islands system - lots to discover 
     Completely reworked our sound system - featuring spatial sound and sounds we had recorded specifically for VR Regatta 
     Ability to adjust sitting height
     New compass - on a sailing dinghy showing you directions 
     Completely rewritten underlying engine - this will make adding new races and boats easier in the future


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/a1403b26ebaa09bdf8336670a2c71618cf0de36f.jpg

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HkjSJjzwFUk

Please leave comments with feedback and ideas for improvements. As this is pretty massive update, there might be still bugs - please report to support@marineverse.com or here and we will fix asap. 

Best regards,
MarineVerse Team

notes.title: VR Regatta 0.7
notes.content:
Ahoy Friends!

Just pushed an update to VR Regatta. On the surface, it may look like not much have changed (if you ignore those new fancy water reflections), however quite a lot have changed under the cover.

This update upgrades game engine and some of the major components (for example the one responsible for water simulation) - so if you notice any problems, bugs or performance regression, please contact us support@marineverse.com 

Some of the changes in this version:


     Experimental wind sound depending on where the player is looking ( in Tutorial, Race and Long Race)
     Option to attach controller to Wheel and Tiller ( use grip button instead of trigger)
     Oculus: Using grip instead of trigger to grab things
     Experimental game progression system ( see http://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/135509758530163792/ )
     Experimental Player's profile ( see http://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/135510393195098530/ )
     Performance optimisation: Single pass rendering 


As always, looking forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback :-) ( please contact us via e-mail or comment here )


Best regards,
Greg on behalf of MarineVerse team.

notes.title: VR Regatta 0.2 - control the mainsail!
notes.content:
Ahoy!

Happy to share that VR Regatta 0.2 just shipped on Steam :-)

New features in this version:

   Basic mainsail sheet control 
Preview
Should make sailing in race and long race more interesting. All the rankings were cleared as the new control changes the game-play.
   Boom can hit you - watch out for it. 
You asked for it :-) 5s penalty when it happens during Easy Race
   Pay what you want for VR Regatta 
Preview
This is an experiment to see if VR Regatta can be funded only by community donations.
Rather than making you pay upfront for Early Access game, you can decide how much fun you had and if you want more. Donate if you want more :-)
http://store.steampowered.com/buyitem/468240/100/1


As always, looking forward to hearing your feedback and ideas on what should we build next. Currently multiplayer is the biggest feature planned in the next release.
